summary: Show the local HTTPS management URL before console login. API impact: none; presentation uses existing service configuration.

guide.reason: Operators see the management URL and unavailable state before console login.

api.reason: No network API changes; local setup renders its existing TLS listener address in agetty.

state.reason: Pre-login console banner text only; nothing persisted.

verification.method: Nine package unit tests and native Debian13 agetty rendering in a disposable container; limits recorded in QA.
